beats.text: After speaking with Aling Nena, Riza asks the midwife what information is needed.
A household profile describes one household. It does not prove that a service was given.
A master list shows who belongs to a group. It does not record that a service was given.
Check the registry to see who received health teaching. Clarify any uncertain entry first.
For an assigned form, confirm the requested details and recipient. Follow the approved local handoff route.
Choose the record for the question, check the information, and do not guess.
